title: Shifts in the Psoriasis Market Suggest Strong Potential for Emerging Oral Therapies
description: The article discusses the growing demand for convenient, less invasive treatment options for psoriasis, with oral therapies gaining traction and potentially challenging the dominance of injectable biologics. Several promising oral pipeline agents, including from Johnson & Johnson, Alumis, Takeda, and Bristol Myers Squibb, are highlighted as potential disruptors in the market.
